survey.sub_type_reason: Sheet is dominated by repeated rows of breakers (Q-prefix, QE-prefix, CB-prefix, F-prefix) each with an ampere rating feeding a named load, organized into panel columns (AFT PANEL DC BREAKERS, FWD PANEL DC BREAKERS, EMERGENCY POWER SUPPLY, EMERGENCY PANEL, GMDSS). A few CT current-transformer monitors, a small relay (Re/) and a terminal block (T/S E) appear but are minor/secondary elements riding on the schedule rows rather than defining the sheet's structure.

survey.notes: Many breaker labels in right-hand AFT column (Q23-Q44) and FWD panel emergency breakers (QE2-QE4) are illegible/cut off at this resolution per source legend annotations (e.g. 'ONYX (...)','PASSAR...','CT...','AFT CON...' etc.). Relay 'Re/' and its contact 'B&G' near top form a small control element feeding into breaker column area - kept distinct from main breaker bank bbox. CT8, CT9, CT10 current-transformer coil symbols sit inline on breaker rows (WATER MAKER, AUTOPILOT PUMP) - monitoring devices, not separate regions given small size. Fuse/switch/solenoid group (F5-F8, SW6-SW9, SO6/SO7) at left feeds BILGE PUMP, FIRE PUMP, TENDER WINCH - treated as its own breaker_bank-like region though it mixes fuses+switches+solenoids. Legend block defining CTB7-10 = QI-POWER-485 variants is a small text legend, not a full component legend. Title block fully legible.
